tools.name: check_before_install
tools.description: Call this before adding a dependency. Returns only the facts a reviewer would be annoyed to discover afterwards: whether the publisher has withdrawn the package, whether it runs scripts on the installing machine, whether its repository is archived, how many advisories are on record, whether the lice

tools.name: check_package
tools.description: Read the current standing of one open-source package: downloads with the window they cover, OpenSSF scorecard, advisory count, licence, whether the repository is archived, and when it was last pushed to.

tools.name: check_stack
tools.description: Read a whole dependency list at once and report what is archived, what carries advisories, what has a source-available licence, and what has not been pushed to in a year. Use when reviewing a package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml, composer.json or Gemfile.

tools.name: search_repositories
tools.description: Find watched repositories whose name contains a string, with their current readings. Use it to discover what is covered before calling the other tools.

tools.name: compare_repositories
tools.description: Hold two watched repositories against each other across downloads, OpenSSF scorecard, advisories, forks, stars and findings on record. Compares only; it does not pick a winner.

tools.name: find_model
tools.description: Find language models by price and context window, from a catalogue read daily across sixty providers. Use this before choosing a model: prices move without announcement and training data is out of date on the day it ships.

tools.name: check_eol
tools.description: Check whether a runtime, database or framework release is still receiving security fixes, and what to move to. Covers about two dozen products read daily from endoflife.date.

tools.name: check_provider
tools.description: Recorded incidents for a hosting or API provider over a window, kept after the provider’s own status page dropped them.

tools.name: list_readings
tools.description: List every reading this server can return, what each one measures, and which require a key. Call this first if unsure which tool answers a question.

tools.name: who_can_publish
tools.description: How many accounts hold publish rights on a package, as the registry lists them. Answers who can put code on your machine, which is a different question from who writes it. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: package_weight_history
tools.description: How the published artefact size has moved over time. Returns the readings taken, not a verdict. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: withdrawn_but_installed
tools.description: Packages whose own publisher has withdrawn them and which are still being installed heavily, with the download figure and the publisher’s notice. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: typosquat_check
tools.description: Whether a name is one edit away from a more widely installed package. States that both names exist; which one was meant is the caller’s call. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: funding_gap
tools.description: Packages that ask for funding, beside how heavily they are installed and how many people write them. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: time_to_fix
tools.description: Days between an advisory being published and a release appearing that postdates it, per package and as a distribution. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: advisory_severity
tools.description: Advisories broken down by severity rather than counted, with identifiers and dates. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: runtime_deadlines
tools.description: Support end dates for the runtimes a dependency set requires, including any already past. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: base_image_check
tools.description: For a container base image: its size, when it was last rebuilt, and whether the OS underneath it is still supported. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: registry_health
tools.description: Recorded outages of the package registries themselves, kept after their status pages drop them. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: provider_incidents
tools.description: A provider’s recorded incidents, grouped by the component that failed, over the whole archive rather than the window its status page shows. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: provider_transparency
tools.description: How long a provider takes to acknowledge an incident: the interval between an incident starting and its first public update. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: provider_terms_changed
tools.description: When a provider last changed its terms or pricing page, from a stored fingerprint of the page. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: model_price_history
tools.description: Every recorded price for a model, with the date each was read. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: model_withdrawn
tools.description: Models that were in the catalogue and no longer are, with the date last seen. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: help_availability
tools.description: For a technology tag: questions asked against questions answered, over time. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: audit_manifest
tools.description: Read a whole manifest and return every reading on record for it, ordered by how much a reviewer would want to know. One call instead of one per dependency. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: diff_since
tools.description: What changed for a set of packages since a given date, read from the daily archive. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: watch_add
tools.description: Add a package to the caller’s own private watchlist, so later readings are about their stack rather than the public one. The list is private to the key that created it. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: watch_changes
tools.description: Everything that has changed across the caller’s private watchlist since a given date: withdrawals, licence changes, advisories, archived repositories and runtimes going out of support. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: explain_finding
tools.description: Given a finding id, return what was measured, when, by whom, and the address it can be checked at. For an agent quoting a figure into a review. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

tools.name: domain_risk
tools.description: Whether the domains a package points at — homepage, funding, documentation — still resolve to a registered owner. Requires a key; see https://sighttrue.com/pricing.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_repositories" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Find watched repositories whose name contains a string, with their current readings. Use it to discover what is covered before calling the other tools.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
